# Design explorations — historical

Discarded options kept for provenance: homepage layout variants and logo studies.

**These use the pre-rebrand palette and are not authoritative for anything.** The
live design system is `src/app/styles/globals.css`, published as the
"Bayan — Design System" project on claude.ai/design and generated by
`scripts/gen-design-system.mjs`.

Do not copy colours, type or spacing from these files.
